title: Bad error message if referencing a file from external repository but BUILD file not found

labels.name: P1
labels.description: I'll work on this now. (Assignee required)

labels.name: team-ExternalDeps
labels.description: External dependency handling, remote repositiories, WORKSPACE file.

labels.name: bad error messaging
labels.description: Issues where users get stuck because they don't understand what they did wrong

body:
See https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/6225#issuecomment-464460656:

```
$ cat WORKSPACE
load("@bazel_tools//tools/build_defs/repo:http.bzl", "http_archive")

http_archive(
    name = 'repo',
    build_file = '@//:BUILD.repo',
    urls = ['https://cdn.kernel.org/pub/linux/kernel/v4.x/linux-4.18.9.tar.xz'],
    sha256 = '4c995351e57902a04a94e43796407b4ba295c8eae070c27e99f8f99c321e917a',
)
$ bazel build @repo//:*
INFO: Invocation ID: 020d0b4c-9544-4e7d-8268-2b88ba48a7e7
ERROR: no such package '@repo//': Traceback (most recent call last):
	File "/usr/local/google/home/dslomov/.cache/bazel/_bazel_dslomov/adb60325bd5e70156e0b5c44c5e553e1/external/bazel_tools/tools/build_defs/repo/http.bzl", line 56
		workspace_and_buildfile(ctx)
	File "/usr/local/google/home/dslomov/.cache/bazel/_bazel_dslomov/adb60325bd5e70156e0b5c44c5e553e1/external/bazel_tools/tools/build_defs/repo/utils.bzl", line 62, in workspace_and_buildfile
		ctx.symlink(ctx.attr.build_file, "BUILD.bazel")
Unable to load package for //:BUILD.repo: not found.
```

"Unable to load package for //:BUILD.repo: not found." does not say what exactly is not found (a BUILD file in workspace root)
